descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S16 「手机上开着病历、正在打字，电脑把这个病人删了」 The computer deletes a patient whose chart is open, mid-typing, on the phone

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time.（UAT TC-25 step 5；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 18；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Phone on {hospitalPatient}'s Pre-Round tab with typed, autosaved text

When The computer removes {hospitalPatient} from the Hospital list (confirm once)

Then Without a refresh, the phone stops showing that patient's name and text, tells the physician something with a way back to the list (not a blank screen), and the list no longer has the patient. The Nursing Home resident is untouched

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone, no reload) mustContain 'Patient not found' and 'Back to rounds' (a message that the patient is gone and a control back to the list; this is main's wording, routes/rounding/Patient.tsx:71-77, and a person confirms once that it reads as the UAT intends) and mustNotContain {hospitalPatient}, 'QA-SYNC-PR-D', 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong' (so a p …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
